nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What visual elements were included on the wobblers in the meat shelf?
nodes.answer: The wobblers included a picture of a meat product on the left-hand side and a meat substitute on the right-hand side, with an arrow pointing from the meat product to the meat substitute.
nodes.paragraph: Dynamic norm communications As property nudges, banners were placed throughout the supermarket communicating a dynamic norm (i.e. Our customers are increasingly buying vegetarian [super - market name] offers a wide range of options ) on floor stickers near the entrance and the meat (alternative) shelves (Fig. 1a). These texts were also placed as stick - ers in the shopping trollies and baskets (Fig. 1b c), and as a banner placed above the meat and meat substitute shelves (Fig. 1d). Wobblers (i.e. bouncy shelf barker) were placed in the meat shelf communicating a dynamic norm Increasingly purchased accompanied by a picture of a meat product on the left-hand side, a meat substitute on the right hand side, and an arrow between the two pic - tures pointing towards the meat substitute to indicate that the meat substitute increasingly replaced the meat product (Fig. 1e).
